instruction: Review how this agreement addresses data subject rights under GDPR Articles 15–22. Identify: obligations to assist the controller with access, erasure, rectification, and portability requests, defined response timeframes, and any gaps that could result in a GDPR violation.

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 15 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".
Defines the substantive standard for the data subject's right of access, which forms part of the Articles 15–22 benchmark for identifying gaps.

elements.description: The individual can obtain processing confirmation and a copy of personal data
Purposes, data categories, recipients, and retention period or criteria are supplied
Applicable rights, complaint route, and source of indirectly collected data are supplied
Meaningful automated-decision information is supplied where applicable
elements.applicabilityGuidance: Applies where automated decisions requiring this information occur. Missing description leaves applicability unknown.

elements.description: The first copy is free and further-copy charges are limited to a reasonable administrative fee

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 16 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: Inaccurate personal data is corrected
Incomplete personal data can be completed, including by supplementary statement
Rectification is completed without undue delay

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 17 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: Personal data is erased in response to a valid data-subject request or Article 17 ground
Erasure covers no-longer-necessary, consent withdrawal, successful objection, unlawful processing, and legal-duty grounds
Erasure occurs without undue delay
Reasonable steps notify other controllers where erased data was made public
elements.applicabilityGuidance: Applies where the controller has made the relevant personal data public. Silence is not evidence that it has not.

elements.description: Any retention exception is limited to Article 17(3)-consistent grounds

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 18 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: Restriction is available as a remedy distinct from erasure
Restriction applies for contested accuracy, unlawful processing, legal claims, or pending objection
Restricted data is stored but otherwise processed only on a permitted basis
The individual is notified before a restriction is lifted

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 19 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: Recipients are notified after rectification, erasure, or restriction
The exception is limited to impossibility or disproportionate effort
The individual is told who the recipients are on request

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 20 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: Portability applies to data supplied by the individual and processed by automated means on consent or contract
Data is supplied in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format
The individual can transmit data to another controller
Direct controller-to-controller transmission is supported where technically feasible

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 21 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: The individual can object to legitimate-interest or public-task processing
Continued processing is limited to compelling grounds or legal claims
Direct-marketing processing and related profiling stop unconditionally on objection
The objection right is presented clearly and separately by the first communication

selectionReasons: Matches the explicit Article 22 request.
Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

elements.description: The rule addresses solely automated decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects
Any such decision is limited to contract necessity, authorising law, or explicit consent
The individual can obtain human intervention, express a view, and contest the decision
Special-category data use is limited to explicit consent or substantial-public-interest law with safeguards
elements.applicabilityGuidance: Applies where special-category data is used in the decision. Without grounded facts, applicability remains unknown.

selectionReasons: Matched named compliance concept "data subject rights".

rule.title: One-month response timeframe and extension notice

elements.description: Requests are answered without undue delay and within one month of receipt
Any complexity or volume extension is capped at two further months
The individual is notified within the first month with reasons for delay

selectionReasons: Matched named compliance concept "assist the controller".
Covers the processor's core obligation under Article 28(3)(e) to assist the controller with technical and organizational measures to fulfill data subject rights requests under Articles 15–22.

elements.description: The processor provides substantive assistance to the controller, not only request forwarding
Assistance is delivered through appropriate technical or organisational measures where possible
Assistance covers the controller's response to data-subject rights requests
